title: Tribological and high-temperature mechanical characterization of cold sprayed and PTA-deposited Stellite coatings
InformationInFigures: Yes. Porosity (Fig. 10), Hardness (Fig. 3 and 4), Elastic modulus (Fig. 2)

experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: Hardness test were carried out on a polished cross section. 1000 mN was also used for nanoindentation. Microstructural analysis was carried on chemically etched (etched with aqua regia (30 ml HCl 37% + 10 ml HNO3 65%)) samples after four-point bending tests

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: the distribution of cobalt, nickel (light grains) and chrome (dark zones) throughout the microstructure was identified. some interlamellar voids resembling cracks contribute to porosity in the coating.

Experiments.Notes: As-spray. Composition noted in introduction, may not be exact same powder: 12.6 wt% (Cr0.80Co0.15W0.05)7C3 carbides in a Co-23Cr-4.5 W solid solution alloy. Reporting values from nanoindentation test at 500 mN (Young's moduli, hardness)

experimentalProperties.Deposit_Post_Treatment_Description: Heating ramp in air furnace as follows: from room temperature up to 40°C at 5°C/min, then from 40°C up to 250°C at 15°C/min, from 250°C up to 295°C at 10°C/min, and finally from 295°C to 300°C at 5°C/min. Dwelled at 300°C for 15 min and then cooled in air.
